description: Implementation of InputFileManager class for managing file loading, parsing, and synchronization in a build system context, including asynchronous and synchronous file load handling, with thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: ScopedUnlock
classes.description: Helper struct to unlock a mutex in constructor and relock in destructor, used for managing lock scope.

classes.name: InputFileManager::InputFileData
classes.description: Data structure holding information about a loaded input file, including tokens, parse tree, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: InvokeFileLoadCallback
methods.description: Calls the provided callback with a parse node.

methods.name: DoLoadFile
methods.description: Performs the actual file loading, tokenization, and parsing, with error handling and fallback paths.

methods.name: InputFileManager::AsyncLoadFile
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous file load, managing callbacks and thread safety.

methods.name: InputFileManager::SyncLoadFile
methods.description: Performs a synchronous file load, waiting for pending loads if necessary, with error handling.

methods.name: InputFileManager::AddDynamicInput
methods.description: Adds a dynamically created input file to the manager.

methods.name: InputFileManager::GetInputFileCount
methods.description: Returns the number of input files managed.

methods.name: InputFileManager::AddAllPhysicalInputFileNamesToVectorSetSorter
methods.description: Adds all physical input file names to a sorter for further processing.

methods.name: InputFileManager::BackgroundLoadFile
methods.description: Loads a file in the background, used by the scheduler.

methods.name: InputFileManager::LoadFile
methods.description: Loads and parses a file, updating internal state and invoking callbacks.
